decisions.decision:
The code is finished and pushed (7b5f59e on origin/main; probe-t263 21/21; tsc clean). Two steps remain.
(1) Deploy: make a fresh detached worktree at origin/main HEAD. Copy in app/node_modules and cloud/node_modules with `cp -Rc`, not a symlink. Then run `bash -x cloud/scripts/build.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/t263-build.log`. It most likely exits silently because `OUT=$("$GEN" | tail -1)` under pipefail hides the export's error. Fix the cause (node_modules or a stale export-static.sh pattern), then wrangler deploy revops-centre from that worktree. Leave the other lane's uncommitted funnel/worker.js out.
(2) Live gate check: load the FintechCircle Tantra key from tantra-redesign/.env into a process env var without printing it. Call GET /accounts?search= for each sender and log CONNECTED or not per sender, with no key in the log.
Then log the result per done-when line, set status review (Adi, Bharath).
decisions.why: Log 2026-10-11: only the deploy and the live GET are left. The key is in .env, which is enough. build.sh line 35 swallows export errors. The mirror-export-clean-worktree memory: a symlinked node_modules fails the export.
